Customer Cases

Real installations across clubs, ranges, hospitality, and private homes.

Lincoln 4S Dealership │ Smart Simulator Empowers Customer Experience

General Manager of a Lincoln 4S dealership leverages the Golfpai smart golf simulator to extend customer stay, enhance the test-driving experience, and turn idle space into an effective conversion booster.

GOLFPAI × Automotive Industry │ Innovation Scenarios & Win-Win Ecosystem

This case explores the strategic cooperation between GOLFPAI and the automotive industry, creating a win-win innovation ecosystem that transforms dealership spaces into immersive sports-experience hubs and enhances brand value and customer retention.

Courtyard Estate // Simulated Fairway Retreat

This traditional Chinese courtyard villa integrates a state-of-the-art golf simulator into its private leisure wing, blending ancient architectural elegance with modern sports technology for year-round indoor practice and family entertainment.

Sushi Omakase // Swings & Sake

This Japanese restaurant transforms its after-hours space into a premium golf simulator lounge — elevating a traditional omakase dining concept into an immersive sports-entertainment hybrid that serves both the discerning golfer and the high-end diner.

Jitang Club: Seaside Swing, Elevated by Golfpai S1

Jitang Club adopts the Golfpai S1 simulator with a curved screen that precisely captures swing trajectories and delicately restores green undulations and grass textures. Members have commented, "The green feedback is excellent, and the realism is extremely high."

Clubhouse Indoor Golf // From Lease Takeover to Greater Vancouver's Most Capable Simulator Venue

Clubhouse Indoor Golf took over a struggling Richmond simulator space, completed a full renovation with six RG Eagleye III bays and three private VIP rooms offering 180+ real 4K courses, and turned it into the Greater Vancouver Area's most capable indoor golf destination — where laggy, inconsistent tracking was replaced by accurate ball flight, zero perceptible delay, and members who once visited return as regulars.

Ground-Up Entertainment Venue // Golf Meets the Bar Scene

From a raw commercial shell in Regina, the team built a ground-up golf bar featuring nine RG Eagleye III bays—including two private VIP rooms—with a full-service bar and lounge seating, creating a venue where golfers and non-golfers can play a world-class course and order a cocktail between holes.

Sun Room Conversion // Multi-Entertainment Suite

A Toronto homeowner transformed an underused sun room with vaulted wood ceilings and skylights into a multi-functional entertainment suite, anchored by an RG Eagleye III simulator with Auto Tee, alongside optional karaoke and home theatre add-ons.
